edges.reason: oneTokenContract parameter is consumed by the constructor to set the owner
factory parameter is used by the constructor to fetch the Uniswap pair
tokenA parameter is passed to getPair in the constructor
tokenB parameter is passed to getPair in the constructor
output_decimals_ parameter feeds the constructor storage write
output_decimals_ is written into the output_decimals state variable
constructor stores the resolved Uniswap pair
constructor stores token0 read from the pair
constructor stores token1 read from the pair
constructor sets the owner address
constructor initializes price0CumulativeLast
constructor initializes price1CumulativeLast
constructor initializes blockTimestampLast from pair reserves
constructor initializes PERIOD to HOURLY
constructor uses the HOURLY constant when setting PERIOD
period_ parameter is consumed by changeInterval
period_ is written into the PERIOD state variable
changeInterval branches on msg.sender to enforce ownership
msg.sender drives the authorization check protecting the oracle period
authorization check executes inside changeInterval and gates the PERIOD write
owner state variable is compared with msg.sender in the permission check
update consumes block.timestamp through UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices
block.timestamp determines the elapsed time and thus the pricing arithmetic, a timestamp-dependency risk
update performs unchecked subtraction and division on cumulative prices
update computes the timeElapsed local from the truncation of block.timestamp
timeElapsed is the divisor of the cumulative price delta, allowing division by zero when zero elapsed
update performs external calls on the pair contract before mutating price0Average/price1Average state
update receives the fresh token0 cumulative price
update receives the fresh token1 cumulative price
update receives the uint32 block timestamp returned by the oracle library
update writes the recomputed price0Average
update writes the recomputed price1Average
update refreshes price0CumulativeLast
update refreshes price1CumulativeLast
update refreshes blockTimestampLast
update reads the previous price0CumulativeLast to compute the delta
update reads the previous price1CumulativeLast to compute the delta
update reads blockTimestampLast to compute timeElapsed
update compares timeElapsed against the PERIOD threshold
token parameter selects the branch in consult
amountIn parameter is multiplied by the stored average price
local amount holds the converted value returned by consult
consult reads price0Average for token0 conversions
consult reads price1Average for token1 conversions
consult compares the token argument against token0
consult compares the token argument against token1 in the require statement
consult performs FixedPoint.mul accumulation that can overflow
getLatestPrice internally calls consult to obtain the price
getLatestPrice queries consult with the owner token address
getLatestPrice stores the scaled consult result in oneToken_
change_ parameter is accepted by the empty priceChangeMax function

normalization_plan.reason: period_ is only used to write PERIOD inside changeInterval and has no independent security meaning
token is a pure selector input consumed only by the consult branch logic
amountIn is only forwarded into the consult multiplication
change_ is an unused parameter of the empty priceChangeMax function
oneTokenContract is only assigned to the owner state variable during construction
factory is only used to resolve the pair inside the constructor
tokenA is only used for the getPair lookup in the constructor
tokenB is only used for the getPair lookup in the constructor
output_decimals_ is only stored into output_decimals during construction
timeElapsed exists solely as the divisor operand of the unchecked update arithmetic
local_price0Cumulative is a transient value used to refresh price0CumulativeLast and price0Average
local_price1Cumulative is a transient value used to refresh price1CumulativeLast and price1Average
blockTimestamp is a transient uint32 value only used to refresh blockTimestampLast
oneToken_ is an intermediate holder returned immediately from getLatestPrice
amount is a transient result written back as the return value of consult
